source_claim: AlphaEvolve-style LLM feedback graders need calibration evidence from real reviewer or task suites before their qualitative scores can be treated as validated evaluator feedback
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve has an LLM feedback calibration report schema, an artifact-inventory schema, grader declarations, task-suite declarations, criterion-quality fields, safe artifact-reference validation, a summary renderer, and schema validation tests. It does not claim a runtime calibration runner, executed task-suite results, grader ablation results, or independent feedback-quality validation.
